test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The currency
P. in the region
Q. depreciated rapidly
R. and investor panic
S. amid fiscal turbulence
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **SQPR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence starts with "S" - "amid fiscal turbulence," which sets the context for the events described.
 
• Next, "Q" - "depreciated rapidly" logically follows "fiscal turbulence" to describe the impact on the currency.
 
• Then, "P" - "in the region" specifies the geographical scope of the event.
 
• Finally, "R" - "and investor panic" concludes the sentence by describing the resulting reaction.

Therefore, the correct answer is **SQPR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (PSQR):** This option starts with "in the region depreciated rapidly," which is grammatically incorrect and ignores the context-setting phrase "amid fiscal turbulence."
 
• **Option 3 (QSRP):** This option starts with "depreciated rapidly amid fiscal turbulence," which disrupts the logical sequence by skipping the introductory context.
 
• **Option 4 (RSPQ):** This option starts with "and investor panic amid fiscal turbulence," which is fragmented and does not prioritize the logical flow of events.
</ul
